mapper.sql: id AS id, key AS key, title AS title, issue_type AS issueType, common_status AS commonStatus, priority AS priority, assignee_id AS assigneeId, epic_id AS epicId, start_date AS startDate, due_date AS dueDate, progress AS progress
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (start_date IS NOT NULL OR due_date IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(start_date, due_date) ASC, due_date ASC, id ASC

SELECT l.source_id AS sourceId, l.target_id AS targetId, l.link_type AS linkType FROM work_item_links l JOIN work_items s ON l.source_id = s.id JOIN work_items t ON l.target_id = t.id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.link_type = 'BLOCKS' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY due_date ASC, id ASC

SELECT a.id AS id, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_path AS filePath, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.content_type AS contentType, a.created_at AS createdAt, wi.id AS workItemId, wi.key AS workItemKey, wi.title AS workItemSummary, u.name AS uploaderName FROM attachments a JOIN work_items wi ON a.work_item_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.uploaded_by = u.id WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
